hypothesis: Longer training with greater early-stopping patience may improve macro-F1; compare two fixed learning rates independently within each architecture.
test_policy: Training and original validation only; do not load test images or use test metrics.
comparison_note: Four fresh runs total: two architectures times two learning rates. Historical CNN outputs are unavailable locally; historical rounded report values are context only, not a controlled reproduction.
stopping_rule: At most 30 epochs, five non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 300 seconds checked between epochs. Final checkpoint verification and training-fit evaluation can add overhead.
